us_route.product_execution_semantics: TARGET_ASSET_WEIGHTS ARE INTENT ONLY. A DOWNSTREAM FRESH L1 RECEIPT MUST REBUILD THE PRODUCT PLAN BEFORE ANY SIMULATED FILL CAN BE RECORDED. BROKER EXECUTION REMAINS DISABLED.
us_route.projected_field_semantics: Legacy projected_annualized_expected_net_return fields remain for API compatibility and still contain weighted historical state-return estimates. Calibrated horizon outputs live only under prediction_adjustment.
us_route.selection_metric_semantics: The internal prediction overlay no longer treats StrategyState.expected_net_return as a future forecast. For H20 and H5 it first rescales that legacy historical annualized state estimate to the matching horizon, blends it without fitted coefficients with same-horizon realized strategy momentum, and caps amplitude at the larger of two trailing daily-volatility sigmas and a fixed empirical absolute-tail floor from completed observations. H20 alone controls promotion and cross-sectional ordering. H5 is consulted only when H20 net scores are equal to numerical precision. H1 is diagnostic-only and may not promote, reverse direction, or overwrite H20. During OPEN/BREAK the newest daily observation is excluded from the prediction horizons because it is incomplete. Immediate switching cost is subtracted directly in horizon-return units and is not annualized. Benchmark state-break and cross-sectional concentration signals are both brake-only; the tighter risk cap wins. No coefficient is retuned from realized post-decision outcomes.
